_comment: Atmosphere & recovery chunk 2: the fixed world campfire — a permanent aligned heal fixture (recovery = time-at-fire, GDD §3). Brazier pattern: role structure = aura always-on, speed 0 = planted, collisionLayer 32 (Viewport ONLY) = structurally unkillable body, collisionMask 16 = Border only. No faction key: an authored 'aligned' hard-fails by design — aurad.go sets FactionAligned post-construction (spawnSummon pattern). Placed from zone.campfires, never from spawns. maxHealth is moot (unreachable body), xpFactor 0, no aggroRadius (a structure acquires nothing). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. interaction: E at the fire opens Bind & Restock / Restock / Fly; range 0.5 + the player's 0.25 body = the 0.75 bind circle (heal radius 1.5 x CampfireDwellRadiusFactor), pinned by a test.
name: Campfire
